messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the launch criteria and resourcing sequence for the tenant-onramp flow. Customer X wants GA in ~6 weeks; product has prioritized latency SLAs + private deploy path. Can eng/runtime/infra/security call out hard blockers?

Aria: Thanks — main product asks: (1) 99p token latency <= 120ms for short chats, (2) private deploy checklist (KMS + audit logs), (3) rollout gating: canary to 5 tenants then open.

Devon: Doable but timeline tight. Two things: runtime needs a KV cache warmup for prefix-heavy traffic, and infra needs a reserved slot for dedicated burst during onboarding. Both need ops runbook.

Sam: Runtime note — KV cache warmup depends on model variant. If we serve q4-quant model for cost, warmup factor increases ~2x. Prefer to serve fp16 for initial 5 tenants to meet 120ms.

Priya: Infra: we can provision a dedicated pool, but it requires a capacity commit and infra PR for tenant routing. Lead time ~2 weeks for provisioning + network egress review. Also need a staging VPC mirror for private deploy tests.

Luca: Security: KMS + HSM integration is fine; primary blocker is audit log retention and key rotation policy — current infra defaults 30d, compliance needs 365d for this customer. We'll need an exception or config work. Also need threat model review for private endpoints.

Maya: Ok — sounds like items fall into three buckets: latency (runtime/eng), private deploy controls (infra/security), rollout ops (eng + infra). Can we get concrete asks + owners?

Devon: I'll own latency work. Tasks: (a) experiment with fp16 vs q4-quant perf and cost by EOD Thu, (b) KV prefetch patch to runtime (small change) — target code review Mon.

Sam: I'll pair with Devon on the perf matrix. Also will surface metrics we need: cold vs warm tail percentiles, per-tenant seq-len distribution.

Priya: I'll own infra provisioning. Tasks: (a) request capacity commit with finance (this afternoon), (b) create staging VPC and routing PR — ETA 10 business days, (c) confirm network egress and private endpoint cert flow.

Luca: I'll run the audit retention change request and threat model. Need product sign-off on data retention justification. Also want a pre-release security checklist itemized.

Aria: Product will provide the retention justification and a prioritized feature matrix for the canary tenants. Also will draft the rollout gating checklist (metrics and rollback triggers).

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline status — staging cluster healthy, latest runtime image passed e2e smoke tests (build-9876). :white_check_mark:

Maya: Action items summary: 
• Devon + Sam: perf matrix (fp16 vs q4-quant) by Thu; KV patch CR by Mon. 
• Priya: capacity request + staging VPC PR in 10bd. 
• Luca: audit retention request + threat model + pre-release checklist (need product justification). 
• Aria: retention justification + gating checklist. 
• Maya: I'll coordinate dates and confirm with Customer X we can do staged canary starting week 4.

Please add any constraints or if anyone needs to shift dates. :eyes:

Devon: One constraint — if we go fp16 we may exceed memory on the cheaper GPUs; need to validate memory footprint, otherwise dev cost jumps. Will flag early if we hit that.

Priya: If finance pushes back on capacity commit, we fallback to shared burst pools but that increases cold-tail risk. Not ideal but noted.

Luca: Also flag: private deploy in some regions requires extra compliance signoff; may impact tenant selection for canary.

Maya: Good flags — I'll update the rollout plan with these contingencies. Next sync: Friday 10am standup. If something blocks earlier, ping #eng-runtime and @Maya.

Aria: :thumbsup:

Sam: Will post perf snapshots as soon as experiments finish.

Devon: Thanks — tuning noise ahead.

Maya: Closing thread — I'll convert action items into a Notion checklist and share link in this channel.
